title: 5-Day Capella Hanoi Ultra-Luxury Golf Showcase
description: Experience Bill Bensley's opera-inspired Capella Hanoi on a 5-night ultra-luxe Vietnam golf package playing BRG Legend Hill, Sky Lake, and Thanh Lanh.

signatureTour.title: The Grand Vietnam Odyssey
signatureTour.highlight: Vietnam’s ultimate cross-country signature expedition pairing Capella Hanoi with The Nam Hai and Park Hyatt Saigon.

inclusions.detail: Executive chauffeured vehicles for all transfers.
3 rounds: Legend Hill, Sky Lake, and Thanh Lanh Valley.
4 nights in a Capella Suite at Capella Hanoi.
Curated dining reservations at Michelin-starred Koki restaurant.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Capella Hanoi & Diva's Lounge Welcome
itinerary.subtitle: Opera Luxury Arrival
itinerary.imageAlt: Capella Hanoi luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Hanoi's Noi Bai International Airport and transfer by private executive vehicle to Capella Hanoi, Bill Bensley's tribute to opera legends. Settle into your individually curated suite.

Enjoy welcome cocktails in the Diva's Lounge before an exquisite dinner at Backstage, celebrating northern Vietnamese flavours in theatrical surroundings.

itinerary.title: Twin Green Precision at BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Nicklaus Design
itinerary.imageCaption: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort — Nicklaus Design (Par 72, 7,068 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort championship golf course Nicklaus Design Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort, navigating Jack Nicklaus’s twin-green layout through the scenic Soc Son hills.

Return to Capella for an afternoon treatment at Auriga Spa, followed by cocktails in the hotel’s opulent salon.

itinerary.title: Championship Water Hazards at Sky Lake Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Tournament Layout
itinerary.imageCaption: Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club — Ahn Moon Hwan (Par 72 / 72, 7,557 Yards / 7,265 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club championship golf course Ahn Moon Hwan Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Take on the championship challenge of Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club, testing your ball-striking against dramatic elevation changes and pristine lake carries.

Return to Hanoi for an unforgettable dinner at Koki, Capella Hanoi’s Michelin-starred Japanese teppanyaki establishment.

itinerary.title: Alpine Valley Splendor at Thanh Lanh Valley Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Faldo Mountain Finale
itinerary.imageCaption: Thanh Lanh Valley Golf & Resort — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Thanh Lanh Valley Golf & Resort championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Conclude your golf rotation at Thanh Lanh Valley Golf & Resort, Sir Nick Faldo’s breathtaking mountain layout. Set beside Lake Thanh Lanh, the course delivers cool mountain breezes and dramatic lakeside green complexes.

Toast the end of your golf trip with drinks on the stone terrace before an executive transfer back to Capella Hanoi for your farewell evening.

itinerary.title: VIP Departure via Noi Bai International Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageAlt: Capella Hanoi luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before packing your clubs with assistance from your AGS concierge.

Your private luxury transfer delivers your party to Noi Bai Airport for your onward journey.

faqs.question: What makes Capella Hanoi unique?
faqs.answer: Each of the 47 rooms and suites is uniquely designed as an homage to famous opera singers, composers, and artists from the 1920s.
